rating_source: Fetched the live GreenPal profile page directly (https://www.yourgreenpal.com/imagine-it-gardening) with curl + Chrome UA (HTTP 200, 377KB HTML saved and parsed). The page's own LocalBusiness JSON-LD block gives aggregateRating {ratingValue: 4.67, reviewCount: 85, ratingCount: 85, bestRating: 5, worstRating: 1}, and the page's own top 'over-all-rating' widget independently displays 'Overall rating 4.6/5' (rounded), consistent with the JSON-LD figure. reviewCount 85 matches the task brief exactly and is corroborated by the page's own '( 85 reviews )' link text.
rating_discrepancy_note: IMPORTANT: the task brief stated 'Rating: 5.0, 85 reviews'. During research, the page's Reviews section header ALSO displays a second, separate widget reading 'Overall rating 5 / 5' (class reviews-over-all-rating). This second widget was verified to be a STATIC/BUGGED template element, not a real computed value: the same live-fetch method was run against the rapalo-landscaping GreenPal profile (a business with a confirmed real aggregateRating of 4.76 from its own JSON-LD) and its page ALSO displays the identical hardcoded 'Overall rating 5 / 5' text in that same widget class, regardless of the real underlying rating. This confirms the '5/5' widget is a GreenPal front-end display quirk that always renders 5 stars near the Reviews header, unrelated to the real score. The true, verifiable rating for Imagine It Gardening is 4.67 (JSON-LD aggregateRating), which also matches the page's own top-of-profile 'Overall rating 4.6/5' widget. 4.67/85 was used on the site as the accurate, sourced figure rather than the task brief's likely-misread 5.0.
reliability_stats_source: GreenPal profile page vendor-info stats block, fetched directly: '64% reliability rating' and '56% repeat clients'. price_range field on the same LocalBusiness JSON-LD is '$20-45' (a marketplace-brokered estimate range, not a published rate card, so not placed on the site as a stated price per FORGE-BRIEF 0.b).

founder_story: From the business's own GreenPal profile bio (real, fetched live, quoted/paraphrased on-site without the source's em-dashes per pipeline style rule): "Honestly.. The work I do comes out good I believe it's cause the passion for landscaping this is not a career nor job to me some call it a hobby that happens to pay... Give me a shot I SPECIALIZE in hedge trimming... I am doing residential and commercial customers... THE GRASS COULD BE GREENER ON YOUR SIDE OF THE FENCE!" Also from the Q&A section, verbatim: 'I am in the landscaping maintenance business for passing the 12th year. Love to be outside all day and interact with clients and their needs.' Note: that Q&A answer (about 12 years) appears to have been written some time ago relative to today (2026-08-08); the site instead uses the more current, directly-verifiable 'In Business since Feb, 10' field (16 years as of 2026) for the years-in-business figure shown in the hero and trust strip, since it is independently dated and consistent with the task brief.

images.source: 48 GreenPal-hosted before/after lawn-mowing photo URLs found in the page's own ImageObject JSON-LD gallery (greenpal-production.s3.amazonaws.com), geotagged across Miami, Doral, Hialeah, Miramar, Cutler Bay, Pembroke Pines and North Miami, FL. 16 were downloaded with curl + Chrome UA and verified with `file` as real baseline JPEGs, 340x255px (GreenPal's native small resolution, same as the valeria/rapalo/otechlandscaping precedents for this platform). Every photo carried a baked-in 'GREENPAL' logo watermark (top ~42px band) and a caption band (bottom ~34px); all 16 were cropped with Pillow (Python) to remove both bands (340x179px after crop) before use, per DESIGN.md's prohibition on gallery captures with text overlays. All 16 crops were then visually inspected one by one (Read tool, rendered as a contact sheet first for triage, then individually for the final 8 selections) before choosing the 8 best real work photos plus 1 founder headshot. One photo (a near-black nighttime shot) was discarded outright for being unusable. The vendor's own GreenPal profile headshot image (400x400 PNG, a real casual selfie of the owner in a beanie/jacket) was separately downloaded and center-cropped to a 300x300 square for use ONLY as a small circular avatar in the About/Experience section, per DESIGN.md's rule against owner selfies/portraits as gallery tiles (same handling as the valeria-landscape-north-miami precedent's founder-david.jpg).

curation_note: All 9 photos used (8 property/work photos + 1 founder headshot avatar) are real, verified GreenPal-sourced work photos or a real founder headshot; none are stock or unrelated. Every source photo required watermark cropping (see images.source above) before use. The gallery mixes finished-lawn shots with one in-progress action shot (mower in use) and one landscaping/planting-bed detail shot to show range beyond plain mowing, consistent with the business's own stated hedge-trimming specialty and residential+commercial scope. The map/address section (variante adaptada, no publicly visitable storefront) was replaced with a real curated photo instead of a Google Maps embed.
brand_vibe: Independent, hands-on South Florida lawn care and landscaping operation run by owner-operator Alejandro Hurtado, in business since February 2010 (16 years) and personally specializing in hedge trimming. No storefront, no fixed price list, no online booking flow of its own: everything runs through the GreenPal marketplace, with availability 7 days a week from 7am to 10pm. A warm terracotta/clay palette (distinct from every other landscaping palette already used in output/, and specifically distinct from the two OTHER landscaping builds completed today in this same batch: valeria-landscape-north-miami's teal #146b60 and rapalo-landscaping-north-miami's jade green #4bd490) on a warm cream/sand base, evoking Florida clay soil, mulch and terracotta planters rather than repeating the 'lawn green' cliche used by most other builds in output/.
